description: The PLA Dalian Naval Academy publishes offshore-wind resource indicators for the maritime region described as the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road. The dataset summarises wind-power density, effective-wind-speed occurrence, energy-level occurrence and measures of monthly, seasonal and overall variability. It also reports theoretical, effective and technological resource measures for energy-development assessment. ScienceDB makes the collection available free under CC BY 4.0. The inspected repository description does not establish the exact temporal span, grid spacing or storage format, and these details need confirmation before numerical use. Resource-potential measures are not turbine-specific generation forecasts and do not account for every siting restriction. They can guide regional screening and capacity-planning scenarios before a detailed generation model is applied. No directly related catalogue entry was found.
name: Temporal-spatial characteristics of offshore wind energy resource dataset for the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road
